entry.name: lessthaneq
entry.digest: Compare numbers as less than or equal to
entry.description: Compares two values to see if one value is less than or equal to a second. Outputs a 1 if the number is less than or equal to the comparison-number or 0 if it is greater to it.

arguments.name: intitial-value
arguments.description: Sets the initial value to be compared with a number received in the left inlet. A float argument forces a float comparison.

attributes.name: fuzzy
attributes.digest: Fuzzy floating-point comparison epsilon
attributes.description: When non-zero, an epsilon value to use for fuzzy floating-point comparison. Note that this isn't an absolute tolerance value, but is scaled to accommodate relative error for very large and very small values. The wordcan be used to denote the systemvalue.When zero (default), standard floating-point comparison is used, which may cause apparently equal numbers to not be detected as such.Theattribute is only available in floating-point mode (when the object is instantiated with a floating-point argument).
